decay.fame: decays at half the infamy rate — being forgotten is also a fate
decay.infamyWeight: -1 tally point per full clean in-game week per group (draft rate), floored at the group's #270 hated floor (permanent residue once Hated)
decay.law: read-time weighting over the ledger; deeds are never deleted; morale NEVER decays (#272)

doctrine: always possible, never instant; redemption is not erasure — it is outliving. There is no state named 'redeemed' in any record; only a Ranger whose recent deeds are good, standing where the ladder now reads
mirrorCost: climbing closes the dark's doors: #274 fence gates read current bands, and the Syndicate's #270 track accrues infamy (betrayal's tally) for restitution done against its interests
never: un-Hate a group to Unmarked (#270 hated floor)
clean a stolen Mochi's history page
buy off a wanted level instead of answering it
note: No new stored shape — redemption is a reading discipline over facts #269/#270/#230/#272 already write. Rates are drafted system data.

roads.answeringTheLaw: facing #230 findings / completing supervision closes the law's files and stops new infamy reports; moves reputation's weather, not morale
roads.quietRoads: #245 rescues +2, #220 reunions +3, #217 gifts +1, donations +1 — ordinary good at ordinary rates; NO redemption bonus (the table is the same for everyone, which is what makes a climb mean anything)
roads.restitution: return a stolen Mochi (+8, #269's largest good deed) + restitution payment (+3); the ONLY act that directly repairs a group's infamy (witnessed return = repair weighting in #270's read)
roads.service: #164 service-class postings +1 each under the daily cap — the cap is what makes the climb a climb
